summary: Thousands have been forced to evacuate as major wildfires continued for a third day in the suburbs outside Athens; 10,000 people were evacuated from Agios Stefanos, 23 kilometres from downtown, and deputy mayor Panayiotis Bitakos urged residents to follow police instructions, saying "It is too late now. Too late." Athens Prefect Yannis Sgouras said strong winds helped strengthen the fires and roughly 120 square kilometres (more than 120,000 stremmas/30,000 acres) have burned, calling it "an ecological disaster," while fire department spokesman Ioannis Kapakis warned the situation remains particularly difficult. Authorities reported 83 major fires from 06.00 yesterday to 18.00 today; no casualties have been reported and no official property damage tally has been made, though Greek media have estimated tens of homes damaged, with the blazes described as the worst in Greece since 2007.
